decisions.reason: s0018 has 護撫命下. 護撫 is acting/provisional 巡撫 (provincial governor), not 總督 (governor-general). Immediate context confirms this: s0023 has 新任巡撫沈秉成 taking the substantive governorship. Idiomatic 'governor-general' is wrong; 'acting governor' matches the Chinese.

s0022 has 重申前命為護撫—the same 護撫 office as s0018. Rendering it again as 'acting governor-general' repeats the error; 'acting governor' is accurate, and the rest of the proposed sentence is unchanged and sound.

decisions.after: On New Year's Eve he feasted his officers and laid ambushes in advance; the Japanese attacked as expected and were routed at Fen Shuiling, where the Japanese officer Fugang Sanzo was beheaded.
decisions.reason: s0083 names 日將富剛三造. 富剛三造 is not 福島 (Fukushima), so the original English is wrong. The proposal correctly drops Fukushima, but the parenthetical 'Tomigō Sanzō' invents an unsupported Japanese reading of these characters. Keep a Mandarin reading of the chapter form—Fugang Sanzo—without that conjecture.

The literal field likewise turns 富剛三造 into Fukushima. Replacing it with Fugang Sanzo restores a reading of the Chinese name without inventing Fukushima or an extra Japanese gloss; the rest of the sentence already tracks the Chinese.
